program.title: soonami Venturethon 11
program.description: soonami Venturethon 11 is a remote, 10-working-day program for early-stage founders, solo or as a team. The edition starts 20 November 2026. Partner prizes listed on the official page are a 5,000 euro AI for good grant, a 1,000 euro best project prize, and a 1,000 euro student builders prize, with a special KPMG track. Applications are submitted on Foundance and screened on a rolling basis. The 10-day Venturethon does not take equity; a later twelve-week cohort is optional and separate.

rules: Applications are screened on a rolling basis. One Foundance form starts the process.
If selected, you pitch live to the soonami CEO, CTO and CGO, then hear whether you have a seat in the edition starting 20 November 2026.
The 10-day Venturethon is remote, 10 working days, solo or as a team, with no equity. Equity only enters if you later sign the optional twelve-week cohort.
Partner prizes listed on the official page: 5,000 euro AI for good grant, 1,000 euro best project, 1,000 euro student builders, plus a KPMG track with mentoring and a demo day on 4 December.
The official page lists cash prizes as sponsored by Globumbus. Grant amounts are stated in euro; no USD figure is published on the page.
